title: Bad-word log-log-depth cylinder bounds and stopped live pressure for the Juggler map
statement: Fix N0>=2 with every start in [1,N0] reaching 1. Put L(y)=log2(log(2y)/log N0), d(y)=ceil(C L(y)), and p_C=(1-1/C)/log2 3. Corrected H(C,A): for all large y and every O-rooted L(y)-bad word w of length d(y), its cylinder among odd starts in (y,2y] has size at most 2^{-d(y)} y+y/(log y)^A. Bad means o_t(w) log2 3-t>-L(y) at every prefix 1<=t<=d(y). The all-word version is REFUTED (juggler_unstopped_cylinder_bound); the restriction is substantive. For C>=5,A>C+e(C), with e(C)=C D(p_C||1/2)/ln2, this gives the bounded-target almost-all rate e(C)-epsilon. C>=19 crosses the unconditional contagion threshold; C>=18 does so under Paper C Appendix C. The weaker stopped live-pressure hypothesis P_theta(C) asks (1/N) sum_{n odd in (y,2y],tau(n)>d(y)} exp(theta o_d(n)) <= ((1+exp(theta))/2)^d exp(o(d)), where N is the odd-start count and tau is entrance into [1,N0]. At theta=log(p_C/(1-p_C)), this gives the same rate. More generally, the no-momentum hypothesis sum_{1<=t<d}(s_theta(t)-q)^+=o(d), with s_theta the odd share of live starts weighted by exp(theta o_t), gives rate C[theta p_C-log(1-q+q exp(theta))]/ln2. It gives C D(p_C||q)/ln2 only at theta=log(p_C(1-q)/(q(1-p_C))), for 0<q<p_C. These restricted and stopped hypotheses remain unproved.
mathematical_domain: Juggler parity discrepancy / nested floor-power cylinders at unbounded depth
tested_range: Not testable as stated (the depth d(y) is 27 at y = 10^20, 75 at 10^100 with N0 = 3.5e8). Depth-<=4 analogue: Paper B Theorems 4.4, 4.7, 4.8, 6.1 with power savings y^{-1/96} on dyadic blocks; depth 5: Theorem 6.3 (two words). Aggregate census with the certified floor N0 = 3.5e8 as target (tao_census): for random odd starts in (y, 2y], y = 10^12 .. 10^50, the fraction of exact big-integer orbits still above N0 after d <= 40 steps matches the odd-start fair-coin probability P[u_t > -L(y) for all t <= d | u_1 = log2 3 - 1] within 3 percent for d >= 10 at every scale (ratios 0.92-1.05); the aggregate odd share along surviving prefixes is 1/2. Fair-coin bad-word probabilities by exact walk count (unconditioned first letter; odd-start conditioning roughly doubles them): 0.052 at (y, d) = (10^20, 27), 0.014 at (10^100, 75), 0.0028 at (10^1000, 145); the least depth giving rate (log y)^{-0.6} is about 17 L(y) (data/research/juggler/tao_reduction/summary.json). Pressure census (pressure_census): tilted odd share s_theta(t) in [0.44, 0.56] for t <= 40, theta in {0.396, 0.6}, y = 10^12, 10^20, 10^30, 10^50 (40000 exact orbits each); cumulative excess over 1/2 equals positive-part noise (0.14-0.26 over 40 depths); live exponential moments within 5-8 percent of the fair-coin DP.
counterexamples: The former unrestricted all-word H(C,A) is disproved for C>1,A>1: J-absorbed-cylinder gives >=y/(216 log y) starts in one absorbed word along infinitely many dyadic blocks. The all-prefix H_q is also disproved for q<1,C>1,A>1. Those prefixes cross the envelope threshold and are not bad; their starts are absent from stopped live pressure. No counterexample to the corrected bad-word or stopped-pressure hypothesis is established.
lean_reference: Problems/Juggler/FateChernoff.lean: conditional bad-cylinder union bound (oddFailures_card_le_explicit); Problems/Juggler/FatePressure.lean: conditional live-pressure Markov reduction (live_count_le_of_pressure). Neither proves the hypotheses.
literature: Terras 1976 / Everett 1977 (Collatz parity vectors, exact equidistribution mod 2^d, density-one finite stopping time); Tao 2022, Almost all orbits of the Collatz map attain almost bounded values (growing target, renewal through Syracuse random variables); Krasikov-Lagarias 2003 (Collatz preimage trees >= x^{0.84}). Paper B (docs/theory/juggler_parity_discrepancy_note.md): depth <= 4 with power savings, Conjecture 7.3 (K_3) at depth 5, Proposition 7.1 (all-depth rate-free equidistribution implies density-one descent).
notes: Scope correction, 9 September 2026: see docs/problems/juggler_absorbed_cylinder.md. The original record bundled a false all-word hypothesis with an open stopped-pressure hypothesis, so its ACTIVE label could not apply to every component. The refuted component now has a separate record. H_q(C,A) is now assumed only on L(y)-bad O-rooted prefixes of depths 1<=t<d(y), with additive error y/(log y)^A and A>C+e_q^Az(C). Artificial E letters after the first envelope crossing give the same martingale reduction. Current elementary thresholds: lambda**=0.4926, required rate >0.5074; conditional Appendix C lambda***=0.5392, required rate >0.4608. Least elementary C for optimized pressure at q=0.50,0.55,0.60,0.62: 19,41,214,1496; for Azuma: 19,41,223,1586. These rate thresholds do not assert any hypothesis. Fixed-depth data and censuses do not prove a growing-depth bound; K3 is neither necessary nor sufficient for the reduction. Do not treat this record as evidence for termination.
